_doc: Manual reconciliation overrides keyed by '<row>,<col>' (the r/c shown in the report). Value = labels.json slug, or 'SKIP' to drop the cell. Persists across re-runs.
_confident_picks: matcher ranked these too low or there's a clear winner
_dup_heading_judgment_calls: two slugs share a heading — picked the earlier/likelier; confirm
_round2_wire_dead_major_figure: make a major-figure tile clickable (was non-interactive)
_round3_reject_wrong_fuzzy_matches: matcher force-fit wrong slugs (>0.82 on weak overlap); SKIP rather than link to the wrong event
_round3b_fix_ordinal_misfits: 'Amos I'→amos-2 and 'Mosiah I'→mosiah-ii: roman-ordinal siblings fuzzy-collided; pin the firsts to their real entries (amos-1, mosiah1).
_round3c_place_era_disambiguation: same-named places that exact-match the Old-World slug but sit in a Lamanite-era lineage; pin to the era-correct entry (otherwise the Lamanite city/land rows stay unplaced).
_genuinely_missing_no_label: no labels.json entry exists for these sheet cells — dropped
